AND status = #{status}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN buyer_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buyTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN seller_id = #{userId} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sellTotal, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN buyer_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buyCompleted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN seller_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sellCompleted, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN buyer_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS buyAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN seller_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS sellAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId}) AND status IN ('pending', 'accepted') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending, 0 AS refunding, 0 AS dispute FROM `order` WHERE deleted = 0 AND (buyer_id = #{userId} OR seller_id = #{userId})

SELECT COUNT(*) AS receivedTotal, 0 AS sentTotal, COALESCE(AVG(score), 0) AS avgScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score5Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score4Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score3Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS score1Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100, 0) AS goodRate FROM review WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorite f INNER JOIN product p ON f.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DATE(create_time) AS date, AVG(after_score) AS value FROM credit_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND create_time >= #{startDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC
